name: knowledge-vault
description: LLM-maintained Obsidian knowledge base (Karpathy-style LLM wiki): ingest sources into immutable raw/, compile them into interlinked notes with provenance, query with citations, and lint/enhance the graph. Every session compounds knowledge.

vault_path.title: Vault path
vault_path.description: Root folder of your Obsidian knowledge vault. Skills and hooks use it from any directory. Leave empty to use the current working directory.

workspace_root.title: Workspace root
workspace_root.description: Folder that /project-status scans for project directories (default ~/workspace).
